Alex Reed: I viewed Flat 2, 20 Example Mews, London W12 8QT with Rowan Pike on 13 November 2026 at 16:00. The contract lists Mira Vale as owner and Northbank Example Lettings Ltd as managing agent.
Rowan Pike: Our company number is 31143720. The owner is abroad. I can ask them for the signed appointment, but I do not have it available today.
Alex Reed: I need to move by 1 December 2026. Is payment required while we wait for authority?
Rowan Pike: No payment is required while we wait. I cannot yet confirm whether deposit protection will be arranged by the owner or our company. I will request the scheme details.

Tenancy agreement
Property: Flat 2, 20 Example Mews, London W12 8QT
Landlord: Mira Vale
Letting representative: Rowan Pike, acting for Northbank Example Lettings Ltd.
Rent: GBP 1300 per calendar month.

The managing agent will provide the owner's appointment and the proposed deposit-protection scheme details separately before payment is requested.
